phase_definition_limit: No source heel or skin sole exists. Contact onset is inferred from stationary-foot onset, foot pitch and subsequent flat forefoot. It is not an exact measured heel event.

phases.name: R_CONTACT
phases.basis: Contact onset estimate: right ankle/toe world-forward position approaches a plateau; toe-up foot settles to flat by12. Heel is not a source joint.

phases.name: R_LOADING
phases.basis: Hip height minimum following right contact.

phases.name: R_PASSING
phases.basis: Swing left knee passes the projected hip center; this is knee passing, not ankle crossing.

phases.name: R_UP
phases.basis: Hip height maximum during right support.

phases.name: L_CONTACT
phases.basis: Contact onset estimate: left ankle/toe world-forward speed falls sharply; flat forefoot settles by28. Heel is not a source joint.

phases.name: L_LOADING
phases.basis: Hip height minimum at early left loading; contact and load are nearly coincident in this clip.

phases.name: L_PASSING
phases.basis: Next-cycle swing right knee passes projected hip center.

phases.name: L_UP
phases.basis: Next-cycle hip height maximum during left support.

adult_reference_status: User-supplied Animation Base Locomotion v3; not Mixamo; adult gait is reference only, not approved child acting.
